contract.attrSyntax: key=value key2="with space" — 写在 open 行 name 之后；不接受 {key="..."}  JSX 风格
notes: 容器名必须是 kebab-case（quote-card，不是 quoteCard）
admonition 不是容器名；用 tip / warning / info / danger / note 之一
compare 外层用 :::: 四冒号，内层 pros/cons 用 ::: 三冒号
<!-- variant=X --> HTML 注释不被解析；variant 必须写在 open 行
containers[].pack 三层 namespace：base（基础契约） / pack:<domain>（领域扩展，多主题共享） / theme:<themeId>（主题专属，仅该主题渲染）

L2 页面局部配置：markdown frontmatter `---
variants:
  admonition: terminal
---` 覆盖主题默认，逐处 attrs.variant 仍优先

containers.description: 文首 tl;dr 摘要块（business-finance / industry-observer 等深度主题）。

::: abstract 摘要
本文论点 …

containers.description: 强警示横幅：文章顶部 / 中部"置顶通告"块，比 tip/warning 视觉强度更高。info 为标题，body 为说明文本。4 种 variant 覆盖：常规警示 / 法律免责 / AI 合规 / 印章公告。
containers.example:
::: announcement tone=danger 重要通知
本期推送涉及账号迁移说明 …
:::

attrs.description: 语义色调（默认 danger 强警示；可选 primary 中性告知 / accent 喜庆通告）
覆盖主题默认的 announcement 骨架。danger-bar（默认）= 左色条 + soft 底；mono-disclaimer = 法律声明监 monospace 边框无填充；ai-notice = AI 生成内容合规告知（含徽章）；stamped-banner = 右侧 SVG 印章戳。

containers.description: 作者栏：单行署名块（名字 + 日期/期号）。与 author-bio 的边界见 author-bio.description。

containers.description: 多行作者简介卡：头像 + 名字 + 身份 + 多行简介。与 author 的边界：author 单行署名，author-bio 是独立块（头像 + 多行 bio + 社交链接），通常用在文末"关于作者"。
containers.example:
::: author-bio avatar="me.png" name="顾留白" role="专栏作者"
非虚构写作 8 年，关注城市与日常。
:::

containers.description: 署名条：N 栏分隔（kicker 小字 / value 主视），data-brief 家族签名。与 author 容器正交：author 是"作者名 + role"两段签名块；byline 是"AUTHOR / EDITOR / SET" 多栏 newspaper 形态。

::: byline cells="AUTHOR:顾留白 | EDITOR:徐稍后读 | SET:04·2026" monospaceLast="true"

attrs.description: 三栏（或更多）署名单元，竖线 `|` 分隔；每格 `kicker:value` 用半角冒号分隔。例：`AUTHOR:顾留白 | EDITOR:徐稍后读 | SET:04·2026`。为零时回退到旧 author 形态（info 作 name + role/issue attrs），但 byline 建议总是声明 cells。
attrs.example: AUTHOR:顾留白 | EDITOR:徐稍后读 | SET:04·2026

attrs.description: 末格 value 是否走 monospace 字体（typically "SET" 期次或日期）。

containers.description: 刊物收束栏：上分割线 + 左右双栏 monospace 元数据（下期预告 / 卷·期）。data-brief 等刊物化主题的"尾签名"。

::::

attrs.description: 骨架：qa-rows（默认 Q/A 行）/ chat-bubbles（左右气泡）/ name-prefix（"名字：内容"行内）/ interview-column（杂志体 N Yorker 风）

containers.description: dialogue 内单轮发言。name 与 shape 二选一必填（shape 以形状代号替代姓名），body 为发言内容。
containers.example:
::: dialogue-turn name="张三" role="A"
你说的没错。
:::

attrs.description: 发言者姓名（与 shape 二选一必填——shape 以形状代号替代姓名时可省）
角色标识（"Q" / "A" / "主持人" / "嘉宾"）
chat-bubbles 骨架下的气泡侧（left = textMuted 左气泡 / right = primary 右气泡）。其他骨架忽略此 attr。
以形状代号替代姓名（用于"形状即身份"骨架，如 shape-speaker variant）。circle = 圆形徽章 / square = 方形徽章。声明 shape 时 name 可省，不消费此 attr 的骨架忽略。
时间戳（用于音频 / 视频访谈整理稿，如 "00:04:21"）。仅 audio-stamp 等显式消费此 attr 的骨架渲染，其他骨架忽略。

containers.notes: 必须嵌在 dialogue 内（外层 ::::，内层 :::）

containers.description: 装饰分隔线。可切 wave / dots / flower / rule / glyph / seal-mark。
containers.example:
::: divider
:::

containers.description: 装饰性副刊头：跨栏大字标题 + 可选 chip 红章 + PP 页码 + subtitle + titleDot 红点。与微信原生标题（H1）正交，本容器输出 <section>，不抢平台 H1 语义。data-brief 家族签名。
containers.example:
::: editorial-header 在无人深夜， / 重新学习 / 如何阅读一本书 chip="ESSAY · 01" pp="PP.04–19" subtitle="论慢读在算法时代的价值" topRule="6" titleDot="primary"
:::

attrs.description: 装饰小红章文字（如 "ESSAY · 01"）。声明则在大标题上方渲染 primary 实色徽章 + hairline。
右上页码区间（monospace 小字，与 chip 同一行 hairline 居中对齐）。
主标题下方副标题（13px 中粗黑字，无字距）。
attrs.example: 论慢读在算法时代的价值

attrs.description: 顶部装饰色条宽度（px 整数，0=不渲染）。Swiss 苏黎世副刊头惯用 6。
主标题末色实心点（PaletteColorKey）。声明则在 info 末尾追加一个该色 "."。
在 info 中作为换行分隔符的字符串（默认 " / "，前后各一空格）。让作者用一行 info 表达多行大标题：`info="在无人深夜， / 重新学习 / 如何阅读一本书"`

containers.description: 文末 CTA 块。两态骨架：button-led（默认）= 单按钮 + 引导文案（关注、投喂、阅读原篇）；triptych-actions = 三栏赞同 / 收藏 / 转发并列动作集（data-brief 家族签名）。href 支持公众号内链白名单。
containers.example:
::: footer-cta 觉得有用？ cta=阅读原篇 href=https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/xxx
如果这篇对你有启发，欢迎关注。
:::

attrs.description: 覆盖主题默认的 footerCTA 骨架。button-led（默认）= 居中标题 + 主色胶囊按钮；triptych-actions = 三栏 CTA（赞同 / 收藏 / 转发，display:table 等宽）。
button-led 按钮文字（visual only）
button-led 按钮跳转 URL。为保证公众号正文可点击，建议用以下几类之一：https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/*（同域文章）/ weixin://dl/*（小程序协议）/ tel:* / mailto:* / 页内锚点 #*。非白名单 URL 会触发 diagnose warning。
triptych-actions 左格文字（默认 ♡ 赞同）
triptych-actions 中格文字（实色，默认 ★ 收藏）
triptych-actions 右格文字（默认 ↗ 转发）

containers.description: 脚注 / 参考文献块。两骨架可选：lined（默认，一条一行 + hanging indent）适合 5~10 条短引用；inline-flow（同段流式排列 + 内滚动）适合 20+ 条长文献列表，作者用 `·` / `／` 分隔条目。info 非空时渲染主色 kicker（如 "NOTES" / "参考文献"），与 editor-note / qa-block 同源。
containers.example:
::: footnotes
[1] 数据覆盖 2010–2025。
[2] 深度理解得分取自 24h 回忆测试。
:::

attrs.description: 覆盖主题默认的 footnotes 骨架（lined = 一条一行；inline-flow = 同段流式）

containers.description: 兜底容器：渲染器刻意不施加主题样式，写不归类内容。

containers.notes: 兜底 escape hatch：无主题样式，按作者内容原样透传。

containers.description: 多图组合：弥补 image-caption 只能单图、markdown 多图串联无版式的缺陷。外层 4 冒号，内部 image-item 列单图。

containers.description: 行内高亮段（bgMuted 底色块）。与 quote-card 的边界：quote-card 是"成段引用"（外部话语、有 variant 骨架），highlight 是"作者自己想强调的一段话"。想强调一句"我要让读者停下来"用 highlight；想引用一段他人话用 quote-card。

commands.name: markdown render
commands.description:
Render markdown → HTML through the full pipeline (markdown-it + theme injection + wxPatch). Canonical name; `render` is kept as a deprecated alias.

`dryRun: true` skips HTML output but still computes wordCount / readingTime / pageConfig / frontmatterIssues (html is empty string, patchLog has no entries). Useful for batch cost estimation before paying for full rendering.

`asDocument: true` wraps the fragment in a complete HTML document (<!DOCTYPE html> … </html>); title is derived from frontmatter, then the first H1 in the markdown, then falls back to "wechat-typeset 渲染". No-op when dryRun is also true.

persona.description: Built-in persona id (mutually exclusive with spec).

platform.description: Publish target id; defaults to 'wechat'. Use `platforms list` to enumerate available ids.

dryRun.description: When true, skip HTML rendering and return an empty html string with patchLog { entries: [], total: 0 }. Metadata (wordCount, readingTime, pageConfig, frontmatterIssues) is still computed.

asDocument.description: When true, wrap the rendered fragment in a complete HTML document. Title is resolved from frontmatter → first H1 → fallback string. No-op when dryRun is true.

commands.name: validate spec
commands.description: Validate a PersonaSpec against hard rules (palette / status 4-states / motif font ≥14 / strokeWidth ≥1 / fontFamily whitelist / variant ids / signatureContainers whitelist). Returns { ok, errors[], warnings[] }; each entry carries `path` + `hint` when matched.

spec.description: PersonaSpec JSON to validate. Schema available via `describe` output → personaSpecSchema (or src/public:getSchema()).

commands.name: validate markdown
commands.description: Check renderability of markdown by running the full pipeline; catches WtException(CONTRACT_VIOLATION / SPEC_INVALID / RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND). Returns { ok, errors[], warnings[] }. For contract-layer lint (fence vocabulary / nesting / inline closure / theme-namespace) use `lint` instead — it is faster and more granular.

persona.description: Optional persona id; when omitted defaults to "default".

commands.name: validate
commands.description: DEPRECATED alias: prefer `validate spec` (PersonaSpec) or `validate markdown` (render check). Dispatches based on which input field is present.

commands.name: markdown lint
commands.description: Contract-lint markdown (fence vocabulary, fence nesting, inline-extension closure, frontmatter, theme-namespace mismatch). Returns { ok, issues[], count, errorCount, warningCount, effectivePersona, personaSource }. When `kind` is `unknown_container`, `nesting_depth`, `unexpected_jsx_attrs`, `fence_not_closed`, or `wrong_theme_namespace`, `name` carries the offending fence name. Canonical name; `lint` is kept as a deprecated alias.

persona.description: Optional persona id; enables theme-namespace warnings.

commands.name: markdown annotate
commands.description: Heuristic block-level patch proposals for raw markdown: scan paragraphs / lists / blockquotes / headings, suggest ::: container wraps consistent with theme capabilities. Returns { patches[], capabilitySnapshot, vocabularySubset, blockCount }. Canonical name; `annotate` is kept as a deprecated alias.

commands.name: markdown annotate apply
commands.description: Pure function `(md, patches[]) → newMd`. Applies the patch plan from `markdown annotate` mechanically: each patch wraps its declared line range in `::: <container>[ variant=X]` (or `::::` for 4-fence containers). Patches are applied in descending line order so earlier ranges stay valid. Returns { md, applied, skipped[] } — overlapping ranges, invalid line numbers, unknown containers, and `wrap_pros_cons` (which requires manual structure) are reported in `skipped[]` with a reason. The function never throws. Canonical name; `annotate apply` is kept as a deprecated alias.

md.description: Original markdown source (line numbers in `patches` are 1-indexed against this).

patches.description: Patch plan, typically the `patches[]` field from `annotate` output.

commands.name: markdown render-batch
commands.description: Render one markdown source through multiple personas in a single call. Returns per-persona ok/html/wordCount/readingTime or error details. Failures are isolated per persona — one bad id does not abort the rest.

personas.description: Ordered list of persona ids to render against.

commands.name: personas list
commands.description: List built-in personas, optionally filtered by topic (case-insensitive substring match on audience + description) or audience (case-insensitive substring match on audience only). All filters are ANDed. No filters → full list.

topic.description: Case-insensitive substring match against audience + description (e.g. "technical", "财经", "人物").

audience.description: Case-insensitive substring match against audience only.

commands.name: personas get
commands.description: Return full PersonaSpec for the given persona id (throws WtException RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND if unknown).

commands.name: personas capabilities
commands.description: Aggregate "what works in this theme" view: defaultVariants, recommendedVariants (designedFor reverse index), containers[] (with available / signature / pack / namespace), kickers.

commands.name: personas recommend
commands.description: Heuristic top-3 persona recommendation using keyword-table + style-anchor scoring. All fields are optional but at least one of title / summary / vibe / audience / topic / style must be non-empty (throws CONTRACT_VIOLATION otherwise). Returns { ranked[], recommendNew, rationaleOneLine }.

topic.description: 题材：技术 / 财经 / 人文 / 生活 / 学术 / 数据 / 文化 / 其他

style.description: 参照锚点（如 FT中文 / Stripe Docs / Kinfolk）

vibe.description: 自由文字氛围/美学描述（如"暖米底圆角，慢生活散文气质"、"VT220 琥珀字"）

audience.description: 目标读者描述（如"技术布道"、"财经内参"、"散文"）

commands.name: personas derive
commands.description: Derive a new PersonaSpec by merging a patch over a base persona. Shallow-merges palette / variants / meta / motifs per key. Returns the merged spec + validation result without throwing on validation failure.

patch.description: Partial PersonaSpec to merge over the base.

id.description: Override id for the derived persona.

name.description: Override name for the derived persona.

commands.name: persona motifs
commands.description: Return the MotifSpec (motif AST collection) for the given persona id. Throws RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND if unknown.

commands.name: containers list
commands.description: Return the container vocabulary, optionally filtered by category (exact), pack (exact), or namespace (exact). All filters are ANDed. No filters → full list.

commands.name: containers get
commands.description: Return the ContainerSpec for a single container by fence name. Throws RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND if the name is not in the vocabulary.

name.description: Container fence name (e.g. tip / quote-card / steps).

commands.name: containers snippet
commands.description: Return minimal markdown snippet for a container. Pass `variant` to bind a specific skeleton. Pass `persona` (and omit `variant`) to bind that persona's default variant for the container's variantKind — useful when generating snippets pre-tuned to the active theme. If the container has no variantKind, `persona` is a no-op.

name.description: Container fence name (e.g. tip / quote-card / steps).

variant.description: Explicit variant id; takes precedence over `persona` resolution.

persona.description: Persona id used to resolve the default variant for the container's variantKind when `variant` is omitted.

commands.name: containers variants
commands.description: Return all switchable variant descriptors for a container. Returns an empty array for containers with no variant system. Throws RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND if the container name is unknown.

commands.name: inline-extensions list
commands.description: Return the full inline extension vocabulary (==mark==, ~~del~~, [.text.] etc.) with syntax, description, regex, input/output examples.

commands.name: inline-extensions snippet
commands.description: Return the inputExample string for a given inline extension syntax (e.g. ==mark==). Throws RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND if the syntax is unknown.

commands.name: frontmatter parse
commands.description: Parse the YAML frontmatter block at the top of a markdown string. Returns config (variants/theme overrides), the stripped body, and any parse issues. Never throws — issues are non-fatal.

commands.name: capabilities
commands.description: Return the full capabilities object (same shape as dist/api/capabilities.json) without writing to disk. URI fields are empty strings when called from CLI; the build script fills them with jsDelivr URLs.

commands.name: error-codes list
commands.description: Return all WtException error codes with their CLI exit code and one-line description.

commands.name: schema get
commands.description: Return the PersonaSpec JSON Schema (draft-07) object. Suitable for LLM structured-output constraints or downstream validation.

commands.name: motif render
commands.description: Render a motif AST → SVG string. Provide EXACTLY ONE of `shape` (plain MotifShape) OR `template` (+ optional `values` for {placeholder} substitution). Passing both or neither throws CONTRACT_VIOLATION.

values.description: Map of placeholder name → substitution value. Only used with `template`.

commands.name: platforms list
commands.description: List all registered publish-target platforms (id / name / status). Use these ids in `render --platform`. status enum: stable | beta | placeholder.

commands.name: variant diff-geometry
commands.description: Compare a variant render output against its design-IR baseline (geometry diff). Returns a structured list of mismatches (display / width / padding / font-size / line-height / color literal). Use this INSTEAD of screenshot comparison to converge on a design baseline.

kind.description: variant kind, kebab-case (admonition / note / quote / highlight / pull-quote / compare / steps / divider / section-title / table-card / gallery / dialogue / qa-block).

themeId.description: Implementation theme id. Defaults to the recommended theme of the design-IR (designTheme → recommendedThemeId).

containerName.description: Markdown fence name (tip / note / quote-card / pull-quote / ...). Defaults to the canonical fence for the kind.

markdown.description: Override markdown to render. Defaults to a minimal fence for the kind/variant.

commands.name: palette lookup-token
commands.description: Look up a literal color hex in the 18-theme palette index. Returns ctx.tokens path suggestions (preferred theme first), so variant authors and LLMs can write `${ctx.tokens.colors.<key>}` instead of guessing or hardcoding hex. Data source: derived from src/core/themes/registry.ts ORDERED_SPECS — auto-syncs with palette changes.

literal.description: Literal color hex (#RGB / #RRGGBB / #RRGGBBAA). Plain CSS color names like "transparent" are returned with empty matches.

themeId.description: Preferred implementation theme id (e.g. "literary-humanism"). Hits in this theme appear in `preferred` / `matches`; hits in other themes go to `alternatives`.

commands.name: describe
commands.description: Self-describing manifest: returns every command name / description / inputSchema / outputSchema, plus error-code catalog, registered platforms, variantIds whitelist, signatureContainers whitelist, hard-rule thresholds, and inline-extension catalog. One call gives MCP / LLM tool registries everything needed to register and reason about the tool.

readOnly.description: true = pure read (safe to cache / retry / call speculatively); false = state-mutating write.

variantIds.description: Whitelist of variant ids per VariantKind. Validators reject anything outside.
